code:
| s result holder |
ZdcPluginSSLSession compile: 'finalize
	"Finalization may run on a stale handle: an image saved with a live SSL
	session holds an index into the previous process''s plugin table after a
	restart, and destroying it raises PrimitiveFailed - fatal inside the
	finalization process (it kills the VM). Tolerate it: the real handle died
	with the old process anyway."

	[ self destroy ]
		on: Error
		do: [ handle := nil.
			FinalizationRegistry default remove: self ifAbsent: [ ] ]'.
s := ZdcPluginSSLSession new.
s instVarNamed: #handle put: 9999.
result := [ s finalize. #noRaise ] on: Error do: [ #raised ].
result == #noRaise ifFalse: [ self error: 'stale-handle finalize still raises' ].
holder := Array with: ZdcPluginSSLSession new.
holder first instVarNamed: #handle put: 9999.
holder := nil.
Smalltalk garbageCollect.
Smalltalk garbageCollect.
#sslHardeningVerified
